question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Irrevocable
solution: The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Irreversible.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: • **Irrevocable** - not able to be changed or reversed. (अपरिवर्तनीय) • **Irreversible** - not able to be undone or reversed. (अपरिवर्तनीय) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • **Unmediated** - without the intervention of a mediator or intermediary. (अंतरवर्ती के बिना) • **Congruent** - in agreement or harmony. (समानुपातिक) • **Irresponsive** - not reacting to something. (असंवेदनशील) • Clearly, the word 'Irreversible' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Irrevocable.' • Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 3. 33:Tc87b,
